svg.text: sudo ipa-diagnose --details (certmonger stopped: not a false 'expired certificate')
REAL LIVE CAPTURE - FreeIPA 4.13.3, Fedora 43, ipa-healthcheck 0.19, 389-ds 3.1.4 - GitHub Actions run 35495088918 (source bdac609)
WHY
ipa-healthcheck (ipahealthcheck.meta.services.certmonger) directly reports:
certmonger: not running. This is the check's own statement, not an inference.
Why the service is not running is NOT determined by this finding.
EVIDENCE
✓ ipa-healthcheck states this service is not running.
IMPACT
Functions that depend on this service are unavailable or degraded. Other
failures in this report (for example ipa-healthcheck checks that could not
connect) may be consequences.
DO THIS FIRST
Check why the service is not running before starting it.
systemctl status --no-pager -- certmonger; journalctl --no-pager -n 50 -u
certmonger
Safety: SAFE — read-only, no state change.
CONFIDENCE
HIGH: Direct report from ipa-healthcheck's service status check.
LIMITATIONS
Root cause of the outage is not established by this finding alone.

service 'certmonger' is not running)
